**Summary of changes:**

Created a new `src/paths.rs` module that centralizes all user-level directory resolution using platform-standard paths instead of hardcoded `~/.bivvy/`:

| Data | Before | After (Linux) | After (macOS) |
|------|--------|---------------|---------------|
| Config | `~/.bivvy/config.yml` | `~/.config/bivvy/config.yml` | `~/Library/Application Support/bivvy/config.yml` |
| State | `~/.bivvy/projects/` | `~/.local/share/bivvy/projects/` | `~/Library/Application Support/bivvy/projects/` |
| Templates | `~/.bivvy/templates/` | `~/.local/share/bivvy/templates/` | `~/Library/Application Support/bivvy/templates/` |
| Reports | `~/.bivvy/failure-reports/` | `~/.local/share/bivvy/failure-reports/` | `~/Library/Application Support/bivvy/failure-reports/` |

**Files changed (7):**
- `src/paths.rs` — new centralized path resolution module with 13 tests
- `src/lib.rs` — added `pub mod paths`
- `src/config/loader.rs` — uses `paths::user_config_file()`
- `src/state/store.rs` — uses `paths::project_state_dir()`
- `src/state/index.rs` — uses `paths::project_index_file()`
- `src/registry/local.rs` — uses `paths::user_templates_dir()`
- `src/runner/telemetry.rs` — uses `paths::failure_reports_dir()`

Project-level `.bivvy/` directories are unchanged — they remain relative to the project root (like `.git/`).
